WITH account_orders AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM "order"
  GROUP BY account_id
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as tot FROM "order"
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ao.account_id,
    ao.cnt,
    ao.cnt * 1.0 / t.tot as share
  FROM account_orders ao, total t
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_s FROM shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT s.cnt, s.share
  FROM shares s, avg_share a
  WHERE s.share > a.avg_s
)
SELECT 
  SUM(cnt),
  AVG(share),
  AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_s FROM avg_share)
FROM above_avg
